name: bitscorecowork
description: BitScoreCoWork — pull and analyze Bitsight Security Ratings inside Claude Cowork, then produce executive reporting, vendor due-diligence briefs, remediation roadmaps, CVE exposure sweeps, framework evidence packs, financial exposure estimates, digital-footprint validation and attribution disputes, regulatory incident notifications across India (CERT-In, RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, IFSCA), the US (SEC, NYDFS, bank regulators, HIPAA, FTC) and the EU (NIS2, DORA, GDPR, CRA), board-level crisis simulations, sector benchmarking, recurring change digests, customer questionnaire responses, and scoped, authorization-gated security-testing plans. An asset by BitScore Cybertech LLP.

bitsight_api_token.title: Bitsight API token
bitsight_api_token.description: Optional. Stored in your OS keychain and passed to the plugin's Bitsight server, so the token never enters the conversation. Leave blank to paste it into chat each session instead. Use a least-entitled token.
